      ],

      "evidence": "\"without exceeding the capacity of the transportation links\" / \"The maximum capacity for transporting resources from City 0 to City 1 is 7 units\"",

      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.05,
        0.1
      ],
      "majority_option": "x[i,j] <= link_capacity[i,j]"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_definition",
      "evidence": "\"minimize the total transportation cost\"",
      "options": [
        "minimize sum cost[i,j]*x[i,j] over directed arcs",
        "minimize sum cost[i,j]*(x[i,j]+x[j,i]) over undirected pairs",
        "minimize total transported volume"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.9,
        0.07,
        0.03
      ],
      "majority_option": "minimize sum cost[i,j]*x[i,j] over directed arcs"
    },
    {

      "evidence": "\"City 0 has a net demand of 2 units ... City 2 has a net supply of 1 unit\"",

      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.15
      ],
      "majority_option": "net_demand positive = demand, negative = supply (outbound - inbound == net_demand)"
    }
  ]
